Extract regression estimates and credible intervals

Source: R/extractors.R
regression_extractors.Rd

Extract posterior summaries from linear and logistic regression fits without refitting or drawing new samples.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bdplm'
coef(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'bdplm'
vcov(object, complete = TRUE, ...)

# S3 method for class 'bdplm'
confint(object, parm, level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

object

A fit from bdplm or bdplogit. Both use class bdplm.

...

Additional arguments are not supported and produce an error.

complete

Logical, for compatibility with stats::vcov(). Both values return the same matrix because these fits do not contain aliased coefficients.

parm

Coefficient names or positive integer positions. Defaults to all coefficients.

level

Credible interval probability, strictly between zero and one.

Value

coef() returns a named numeric vector; vcov() returns a square matrix with matching coefficient names; confint() returns a matrix with one row per selected coefficient and two columns giving the lower and upper posterior quantiles.

Details

Coefficients are posterior means on the original covariate scale, with the intercept named (Intercept). Logistic coefficients remain on the log-odds scale. The residual SD sigma is excluded; use tidy(object, effects = "sigma") for that parameter in a linear model.

Despite the conventional function names, confint() returns equal-tailed posterior credible intervals, using stats::quantile() with its default interpolation. vcov() returns the sample covariance of the saved coefficient draws, including their posterior correlations. It is neither a frequentist sampling covariance nor the Monte Carlo covariance of the estimated posterior means.

See also

tidy, posterior_draws, nobs.bdpbinomial

Author

Graeme L. Hickey

Examples

set.seed(42)
current <- data.frame(treatment = rep(0:1, each = 20))
current$y <- 2 + current$treatment + rnorm(40)
historical <- current
historical$y <- 2 + historical$treatment + rnorm(40)
fit <- bdplm(y ~ treatment, data = current, data0 = historical,
  method = "fixed", number_mcmc_alpha = 100,
  number_mcmc_sigmagrid = 100, number_mcmc_sigma = 50,
  number_mcmc_beta = 200)
coef(fit)
#> (Intercept)   treatment 
#>   2.0827151   0.7207231 
vcov(fit)
#>             (Intercept)   treatment
#> (Intercept)  0.03975653 -0.04218306
#> treatment   -0.04218306  0.10341119
confint(fit, parm = "treatment", level = 0.9)
#>                5%      95%
#> treatment 0.16551 1.231625
